contents: MAI: Hmm.
A young woman wearing a black winter jacket and a black baseball cap walks into a bedroom from the hallway.
She sets her brown backpack down on the bed.
She takes off her heavy black jacket, revealing a white long-sleeved top.
She removes her black baseball cap and hangs it on the coat rack as well.
Slings the backpack over her shoulder, she turns and walks out of the bedroom into the living area.
The woman is arriving indoors and shedding her outdoor winter layers to get comfortable.
<voice_0> belongs to the young woman as she walks through the apartment.
Deepgram: Hello, robot. What have you prepared for me for my afternoon tea? | MAI: Hello, robot. What have you prepared for me for my afternoon tea?
Deepgram: Well, it's ten to four now. Please give me a milk at first. Okay. | MAI: Mm, well, it's 10 to 4 now. Please give me a mocha first.

Deepgram: Hello, robot. What have you prepared for me for my afternoon tea? There are coffee, fries, and cake with two types of cake strawberry and banana. Okay. | MAI: There are coffee, fries, and cake with two types of cake, strawberry and banana.
Deepgram: and cake with two types of cake strawberry and banana. Okay. | MAI: Okay.
A woman stands near a dining table in an apartment holding a smartphone.
<voice_11> lists available afternoon tea items including coffee, fries, and cakes.
<voice_12> responds with an acknowledgment.
<voice_10> checks the time and orders a mocha first.
The camera pans towards the wall near the entrance, showing hanging keys and an electric kettle.
<voice_11> represents the automated smart home assistant providing menu recommendations.
Deepgram: Okay. Thank you, robot. Oh my god. Let me see. | MAI: Okay, thank you, robot. Oh my God, let me see.
A person wearing black gloves unscrews a bottle of coffee.
The person pours the coffee into a white mug on the counter.
The person recaps the bottle and picks up the mug.
The woman sips the beverage before setting it down and looking at her smartphone.
The person filming steps back as the woman continues working.
The woman speaking is <voice_21>, who humorously addresses the person serving her as a robot.
The person in black gloves prepared and delivered a drink to support the woman while she studied.
